assertions.description: The GamepadButton interface is exposed on the global object.
GamepadButton.prototype exposes the new type attribute (requires a build with CL 7760763 and the GamepadButtonTypes flag).
type is a readonly IDL attribute: an accessor property with a getter and no setter.
Per WebIDL, the type accessor on the prototype is enumerable and configurable.
Backward compatibility: GamepadButton keeps its pressed, touched, and value members alongside the new type attribute.
On a connected Standard Gamepad, buttons at indices 0-16 each report type === "standard".
assertions.test: Requires a physical controller: connect a pad with mapping "standard", press a button to expose it, then verify navigator.getGamepads()[0].buttons.slice(0,17) all report type "standard".

assertions.description: On a connected DualShock 4 / DualSense, the touchpad-press button reports type === "trackpad" rather than requiring vendor id sniffing.
assertions.test: Requires a physical Sony controller: connect it, press the touchpad, and verify the corresponding GamepadButton (index 17 in Chrome's mapping) reports type "trackpad".

assertions.description: Every button on a connected pad returns one of the GamepadButtonType enum values: "standard", "non-standard", or "trackpad".
assertions.test: Requires a physical controller: with the type attribute exposed, verify every entry of pad.buttons reports one of the three enum strings and no other value.
